edition.authority: Pope John Paul II; Catholic Church
edition.notes: The definitive Latin typical-edition baseline promulgated by Laetamur magnopere. No acquired artifact is attached to this baseline because the acquired Vatican Latin web pages are a later delivery state that incorporates the 2018 revision of paragraph 2267; that amendment must not be silently read back into the fixed 1997 state.
edition.publication: Catechismus Catholicae Ecclesiae, editio typica (Vatican City: Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 1997)
edition.title: Catechismus Catholicae Ecclesiae, editio typica

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The universal Catechism promulgated in its first French text in 1992 and in its definitive Latin typical edition in 1997. Edition records distinguish language, translation, dated delivery state, and amendments rather than treating paragraph numbers alone as exact textual identity.
work.title: Catechism of the Catholic Church
